episodes.title: Ghost in Wonderland, Part 1
episodes.summary: Ruben moves to a new town where he encounters strange characters at school.

episodes.title: Ghost in Wonderland, Part 2
episodes.summary: The kids must return characters from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland back into their book.

episodes.title: The Jungle Ghost, Part 1
episodes.summary: Ghostwriter releases Mowgli from The Jungle Book to help find Grandma's missing cat.

episodes.title: The Jungle Ghost, Part 2
episodes.summary: Mowgli goes missing and the kids have to work with Bagheera to get him home safely.

episodes.title: The Wild, Wild Ghost, Part 1
episodes.summary: A cowboy is released into the world to help find a secret letter with a Ghostwriter clue.

episodes.title: The Wild, Wild Ghost, Part 2
episodes.summary: A marshal looking for the cowboy seeks help, but the kids don't know who to trust.

episodes.title: The Wild, Wild Ghost, Part 3
episodes.summary: The kids discover what the mysterious key opens, with help from an unlikely source.

episodes.title: A Sparkly Ghost, Part 1
episodes.summary: When the kids partner with Raine to dig into Grandma's memories, they make a surprising discovery.

episodes.title: A Sparkly Ghost, Part 2
episodes.summary: Wondering if Grandma's "unfinished business" involves an old friend, Ruben and Raine track down Sofia to see if she's "S".

episodes.title: A Sparkly Ghost, Part 3
episodes.summary: The kids find a sparkle memory of the bookstore's opening day, revealing more secrets that Ruben's grandma kept from his grandpa.

episodes.title: Franken-Ghost, Part 1
episodes.summary: Just as the kids are hitting a dead end in the mystery, Magnesium takes things to the next level by releasing characters from "Frankenstein."

episodes.title: Franken-Ghost, Part 2
episodes.summary: Things don't go as expected when the kids attempt to build a new creature to appease Frankenstein's monster.

episodes.title: Franken-Ghost, Part 3
episodes.summary: It's up to the kids to save the day when it turns out the new monster is not only heartless, but visible to everyone.

episodes.title: The Ghostly Paintbrush, Part 1
episodes.summary: When Ghostwriter seemingly brings Ruben's paintings to life, the kids think it's just for fun. But then, Ruben's brush goes missing.

episodes.title: The Ghostly Paintbrush, Part 2
episodes.summary: The kids must find the missing paintbrush before Ruben's living paintings become a disaster—especially the dragon.

episodes.title: Ghost Cab, Part 1
episodes.summary: A '50s taxi driver is released from a poem, but things aren't what they seem when spy equipment is discovered in his cab.

episodes.title: Ghost Cab, Part 2
episodes.summary: The kids investigate whether the taxi driver is part of the larger mystery—and whether the poem's locations have a hidden meaning.

episodes.title: The Case of the Missing Ghost, Part 1
episodes.summary: To help with their mystery, Ghostwriter provides a special fictional character: Sherlock Holmes. Except this is no ordinary Holmes.

episodes.title: The Case of the Missing Ghost, Part 2
episodes.summary: When Watson leaves, Sherlock and the kids are led to a storage unit containing a typewriter and clues pointing them towards a secret manuscript.

episodes.title: The Case of the Missing Ghost, Part 3
episodes.summary: The kids try to find the illustrious sparkle house in hopes that the missing manuscript is there.

episodes.title: Ghost Castaways, Part 1
episodes.summary: The kids are still on the hunt for the missing manuscript. Ghostwriter sails in to help—with a most peculiar vessel.

episodes.title: Ghost Castaways, Part 2
episodes.summary: Ruben's lost in time. To get him back, Chevon, Curtis, and Donna need to decide if a pirate's life is for them.

episodes.title: Ghost Castaways, Part 3
episodes.summary: The kids are in a race against time to find the missing manuscript before Captain Vincent can get to it.

episodes.title: The Ghost Writer, Part 1
episodes.summary: To solve a mystery involving famed private eye Owen Quinn, the kids must enter the book and become its characters.

episodes.title: The Ghost Writer, Part 2
episodes.summary: A stolen art exhibit called The Cobalt Mask is found in Quinn's office. The kids question his innocence.

episodes.title: The Ghost Writer, Part 3
episodes.summary: The kids have a plan to save the bookstore, but it means finishing Mason Briggs' last manuscript, which won't be easy.

episodes.title: Ghost of Oz, Part 1
episodes.summary: New friends Nia, Samir, and Charli meet a trio of Wizard of Oz-inspired characters and set out on a curious journey.

episodes.title: Ghost of Oz, Part 2
episodes.summary: Oliver inspires a campus-wide search for answers. Nia struggles with a stranger's accusation.

episodes.title: Ghost of Oz, Part 3
episodes.summary: As Samir tries to connect with the characters, an adversary stirs up trouble. More of Oliver's past comes to light.

episodes.title: The Magic Ghost, Part 1
episodes.summary: Nia, Samir, and Charli cross paths with a young magician and learn about the Eloquent Peasant's disappearance.

episodes.title: The Magic Ghost, Part 2
episodes.summary: As Charli prepares for a big performance, the crew looks for clues from Oliver. Samir's father opens up about his family history.

episodes.title: The Ghost, the Mouse, and the Motorcycle, Part 1
episodes.summary: Oliver releases a tiny-but-mighty character to help the crew explore a secret tunnel. Nia meets a mentor and crafts a plan for change.

episodes.title: The Ghost, the Mouse, and the Motorcycle, Part 2
episodes.summary: Thanks to Ralph, the group learns more about the Eloquent Peasant thief. Nia kickstarts a movement — and confronts a familiar challenge.

episodes.title: He's a Ghost, She's a Rainbow, Part 1
episodes.summary: As the gang investigates Alex Thompson, a colorful shape-shifter arrives to help with a series of undercover missions.

episodes.title: He's a Ghost, She's a Rainbow, Part 2
episodes.summary: Determined to find evidence, Detective Donovan visits Nia's home. As tension mounts, Rainbow struggles to stay vibrant.

episodes.title: The Ghost's Web, Part 1
episodes.summary: Samir spends time with Oliver's nephew. Nia leaps into the pages of a classic novel. Charli grows suspicious of a nosy friend.

episodes.title: The Ghost's Web, Part 2
episodes.summary: Nia and Charlotte work hard to help Wilbur. Samir and Charli gather vital evidence. Village Books hosts Oliver's memorial.

episodes.title: The Eloquent Ghost on the Bayou, Part 1
episodes.summary: In order to take down their suspect, the friends try to sway someone from his inner circle. Oliver releases another character.

episodes.title: The Eloquent Ghost on the Bayou, Part 2
episodes.summary: Season finale. Nia, Charli, and Samir attempt to beat their suspect at his own game — with help from new allies and one crucial character.
